 "command": "cat > programs/task-14dbcfb8.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Mark the background suffix after each row's rightmost colored cell as 1."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        colored = [c for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != background]
        if colored:
            end = max(colored) + 1
            out[r][end:] = [1] * (len(row) - end)
    return out
PY
